summary: Eltek Ltd., an Israeli printed-circuit-board maker listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a CEO transition. CEO Eli Yaffe, 71, is retiring effective September 23, 2026, after leading since July 2018; the Board appointed current CFO Ron Freund, 62, as CEO effective the same date, with Freund retaining the CFO role until a successor is named. Yaffe will join the board effective March 8, 2027, serving until the next annual general meeting. No financial terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks apply. Watch for CFO succession and any strategy shift.
